lastTask: Implement Byte 11c-a bounded melody register shift

projectState.summary: Byte 11c-a is implemented on `codex/byte-11c-a` and ready for review. Melody slow-thinking now allows `shift_register`; accepted register intents derive a bounded one-octave shift from source/target octave, expose it through `window.thinking.getSlowPlayback().registerShift`, and apply it as a pitch override to existing scheduled melody notes only. Shifted events are tagged `thought:shift_register` plus `register:+/-N`. Pulse/bass are untouched, no note slots are added or reordered, and future material injection still belongs in the commit/lookahead path. Validation: `npm run build`, `npm audit`, `git diff --check`, and full `npm run smoke` passed. Note: Playwright/Tone smoke needs an unsandboxed browser run; sandboxed Chromium can render and queue slots while Tone's transport clock stays pinned at 0.
